items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I played with him. Mickey Markle is the only one that ever recorded with a Halfway House band.

ctx.x: Who was the piano player with Bill? The session with rap. What's called?
Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle. Mickey Markle is the only one. He's the only one. Yeah. Did you ever make any records with him?
Yeah. Did you ever make any records with him?
